# Bundled upstream sources

Source snapshots are committed so installation preserves this fork's changes.
Do not replace these directories with unmodified upstream clones.

- [oandrew/ipod](https://github.com/oandrew/ipod), baseline `3762132cc9ad94c5301dddb9365a923350e0020f`, modified for BlueZ metadata and playback controls.
- [oandrew/ipod-gadget](https://github.com/oandrew/ipod-gadget), baseline `ece6b7b0b29dacb7be0cf9f6436fc390892969e8`.

Upstream license files are retained in their respective directories.
